Spacious & Bright Two-Story Townhouse-Style Condo in Kitsilano

3440 W Broadway #126, Vancouver, BC

Discover this beautifully updated, unfurnished two-story townhouse-style condo in the heart of Kitsilano. This bright, south-facing home offers 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a spacious laundry room, ample storage, and a private fenced yard, combining comfort, privacy, and convenience.

Property Features:
- Two-story townhouse-style layout
- South-facing with plenty of natural light
- Private fenced yard and spacious patio, perfect for outdoor dining and relaxing
- Modern kitchen with granite slab countertops, stainless steel appliances, gas stove, and ample cabinetry
- Open-concept living and dining area
- Cozy electric fireplace
- Spacious laundry room and ample storage
- Gas and in-floor heating included in rent
- 2 portable air conditioning units included
- One underground parking stall included

Building Amenities:
- Rooftop access!
- Children's playroom
- Secure bike storage
- Workshop

Prime Kitsilano Location:
Ideally situated along W Broadway near Collingwood Street and Waterloo Street, with convenient access to transit, shops, cafes, restaurants, and everyday amenities. Close to Bayview Community Elementary, Wallace Park, and the W 10th Avenue neighbourhood, with easy access to UBC and Downtown Vancouver.

Rental Details:
- Minimum 1-year lease
- Tenant insurance required
- Pets allowed
- Gas and in-floor heating included

Professionally managed by RE/MAX Heights Realty.
